title: Redesigned Lakewatch Overview page and navigation
body: The Lakewatch **Overview** page now opens with a Genie question box and shows the last 7 days of ingestion and signal activity, with tabs for open alerts and system errors. The environment and SQL warehouse pickers moved to the **Environment, workspace and compute** menu in the top navigation bar. See [The Overview page](/aws/en/lakewatch/introduction-to-lakewatch#the-overview-page).
